history.name: Any past edition can be reprinted
history.description: Any release's edition can be printed again at any time, or all of them at once, and each comes back reproducing what was presented at that moment — including what was new about it then. A lost file is never a lost record.
history.dev_notes: `ledger build --pdf --version N|all`; possible because a feature's state at any version is derivable from its history.
